description_en: Enables the secure access proxy feature for a database instance
description_zh: 调用CreateProxy接口，开启实例的数据安全访问功能
name: CreateProxy

parameters.help_en: The ID of the database instance. You can call the ListInstances (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/data-management-service/latest/listinstances) or GetInstance (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/data-management-service/latest/getinstance) operation to query the database instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The username of the database account
parameters.name: username

parameters.help_en: The password of the database account
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the GetUserActiveTenant (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/data-management-service/latest/getuseractivetenant) operation to query the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid
